summary: First backend iteration for LobiImo. Wrote a 41-test pytest suite covering health, auth (register client/owner, admin reject, admin login, /me, wrong password), properties CRUD (create pending, admin publish, filters, detail, cross-owner delete 403), favorites (add/list/remove + owner 403), interests (create, per-role visibility, admin PATCH, client PATCH 403), payments (manual commission 800 for location and 15000 for vente, list, Stripe pending, mark-paid), admin stats/users, and RBAC (client property 403, non-admin admin/* 403, owner interest PATCH 403, missing token 401). All 41/41 tests PASSED against the public preview URL. Commission rules confirmed: 1 month rent for location, 10% for vente. Stripe endpoint tolerated (test key produced a valid session URL in this run).

minor.issue: Registration returns 200 instead of 201 (spec-level minor). Frontend already handles 200, so no blocking impact.
Creation returns 200 instead of 201. Not a functional bug.
Duplicate favorite is silently swallowed via bare except Exception. Works, but hides potential DB errors; consider catching only DuplicateKeyError.

action_items: No blocking backend fixes required. Optional: (1) return 201 on POST create endpoints, (2) narrow the except in add_favorite to DuplicateKeyError only, (3) consider adding an index on payments.interest_id for faster lookups if volume grows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~785 lines; still readable but nearing the 700-line soft limit — consider splitting into routers (auth, properties, interests, payments, admin) before adding more endpoints.
Environment variables are properly required via os.environ[...] (fails fast). Good.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projections and dict-comprehensions.
Stripe exception handling is broad (except Exception) but appropriate here since fallback to empty stripe_url is the intended behavior per spec.

Interest de-dup on POST /api/interests silently returns the existing open interest (status<>closed). Behavior is fine, but consider returning 200 vs a distinct signal so the client can differentiate 'already interested'.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 users (1 client, 2 owners) with TEST_ email prefix; 3 properties with 'TEST' titles; 3 interests; 3 payments (2 manual paid, 1 stripe marked-paid). Not cleaned up — safe to keep as regression seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_lobiimo_backend.py and is idempotent (uses uuid-suffixed emails). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_lobiimo_backend.py -v. Base URL is read from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin creds: admin@lobiimo.cd / LobiImoAdmin2026!. Stripe key sk_test_emergent actually returned a valid checkout session URL in this run.
